_comment: Runtime AI configuration. Edit this file after deployment and refresh the page - no rebuild needed. Flow: 1) POST auth.dsp.tokenUrl with the credentials below -> DSP returns response.json containing auth.dsp.tokenPath (issued_token); 2) that token is placed in auth.headerName (X-HSBC-E2E-Trust-Token) and used to call auth.endpoint (qwen3-LLM); 3) the answer is read from choices.message.content. auth.dsp.tokenBody supports nested {{username}} / {{password}} / {{apiKey}} / custom placeholders filled from the UI settings panel. extraHeaders values support {{uuid}} (fresh UUID per request); extraBody is merged into the chat completions payload. proxyAiRequests=true routes both the DSP token request and the LLM chat request through the same-origin proxy {backendBaseUrl}/dsp-token and {backendBaseUrl}/llm, which is REQUIRED because the HSBC gateways do not allow browser CORS. In production, configure your web server (nginx, etc.) to forward these two paths to auth.endpoint and auth.dsp.tokenUrl respectively.
